I have farmed in Lindi for many years and know that buying fertilizer or improved seed for maize is too costly when money is tight and the shop is far. My family will work this plot with our hand hoes, though I will pay a few workers to help with the hardest weeding since the plot is large. I will not spray chemicals or irrigate because we rely on the rains and keep costs low.
